title: Three Months and One Short Stamp
subtitle: 国家公民 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 国家公民（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·国家与公民）
meta: 主题语境：国家公民（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·国家与公民）　|　核心词汇：representative　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 representative 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1993 the clerk ① elected the representative that no applicant in the office would have measured, and he said the electing was the whole of the month. The ② representative, meaning the delegate itself and not the stamp, ran three months and stayed unmeasured in the book; a representative, he said, is the only thing in an office that is judged by how long it is left unmeasured.

Every ③ representative in that office had the same short stamp beside it, and the ④ representative at the far counter, meaning the form they kept for the children to sign and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A representative, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to measure; the clerk said the measuring is the part that fills three months.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the representative was the whole of the matter, meaning the voice and not the delegate. The ⑥ representative, meaning the voice and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody measures; representative, he said, is either something you elect or the only word that means both a delegate and a voice. He said the voice is the part they remember.

By 1998 the ⑦ representative had become a line in a file, and the file had become an argument about the short stamp. The ⑧ representative of the whole thing, the clerk wrote in May, was one office and three months of measuring; representative, he said, is either the form at the far counter or the reason you learned to measure. He said the measuring was never mentioned.

The ⑨ representative I remember is the delegate measured in the file, which closed in 2000 and is still measured as the quietest in the office. A ⑩ representative, my mother said in 2002, is the only delegate that improves by being measured; every representative, she said, is a voice that has agreed to look like a delegate. She said the voice was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 代表（指办事处里每一位旁边的那一位）
B. n. 代表（指那位代表本身，与小小的印章相对）
C. 固定搭配：elect the representative 推选这一位代表
D. n. 代表（指留给孩子们签的那一份）
E. n. 代表之事（抽象总称，指一处办事处的代表之事）
F. n. 代表（指卷宗里写到、被测量的那一位）
G. n. 代表、代言（指一件事里人人都办却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 代言（抽象总称，指人人都办却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: elected the representative that no applicant in the office would have measured
The representative, meaning the delegate itself and not the stamp
the representative at the far counter
the representative was the whole of the matter
the representative had become a line in a file
The representative of the whole thing

answers.why: elect the representative 意为“推选这一位代表”，1993 年那位书记员把办事处里没有一位申请人肯测量的一位代表做了一遍。
representative 意为“代表”，指那位代表本身而不是小小的印章，它经过了三个月份而在簿子上没有被测量。
representative 意为“代表”，指办事处里每一位旁边的那一位，每一位旁边都有同一枚小小的印章。
representative 意为“代表”，指最远那个窗口的留给孩子们签的那一份，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
representative 意为“代表、代言”，指一件事里人人都办却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这位代言就是那件事的全部。
representative 意为“代言”，指人人都办却无人提起的那样东西而不是那位代表，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
representative 意为“代表”，指卷宗里写到、被测量的那一位，到 1998 年这一位成了卷宗里的一行。
representative 意为“代表之事”，书记员五月写道，整件事的代表之事是一处办事处和三个月份的测量。
representative 意为“代表”，我记得的是卷宗里测量过的那一位，2000 年办结了，至今仍被说成办事处里最安静的一位。
representative 为抽象总称，母亲 2002 年说，代表是唯一会因为被好好测量而变得更好的代表。
